correctness.rationale: The exact Laurent identity A(x)^3=A(x^3)+3Q(x) yields all three mod-9 digit-appending recurrences with the correct boundary values T_0=T_1=1,T_2=3. The modular Lucas reduction is proved, the first 2-digit correction and its persistence are derived, and a second 2 forces divisibility by 9. Two disjoint classes of length-k digit strings yield 3^k-(k+6)2^(k-2). The independent exact-integer recurrence checker verified all 6561 indices below 3^8 and 2185 positive recurrence indices; these checks do not substitute for the proof.

evidence: Hou and Li, arXiv:2312.13613, Thms. 1.2-1.3, prove weighted sums of products T_k T_(k+1) modulo powers of their limits, not pointwise 9-divisibility.

Mikic, arXiv:2311.14623, Theorem 8 evaluates divisibility by the generalized trinomial parameter b, which is b=1 in the ordinary central trinomial specialization; Theorem 5 concerns central Delannoy numbers.
Rowland and Yassawi, arXiv:1310.8635, Sec. 4.2 is an automaton modulo 4 for the same central trinomial sequence.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The arithmetical objects, moduli, and quantifiers differ. None of these statements implies the new ternary-language criterion without additional modulus-9 arithmetic; the latter is supplied by the Laurent expansion and proof.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The new language strictly refines the known mod-3 criterion: one 2 can contribute either a single factor of 3 or at least two, governed by adjacency and suffix length. Mod-3 digit avoidance cannot distinguish these.

originality.rationale: Four potentially covering mathematical sources were materially inspected: the pointwise mod-3 digit theorem and mod-5 automaton in Rampersad--Shallit 2022; the mod-4 central-trinomial example and generic prime-power method in Rowland--Yassawi 2014; the trinomial-product-sum congruences of Hou--Li 2023; and the generalized-parameter divisibility formulas of Mikic 2023. None states a ternary digit-language criterion modulo 9 or its exact per-length enumeration. OEIS A002426 lists the mod-3 observation, not this mod-9 language. Generic algorithmic constructibility is not itself an explicit structural classification. Residual unindexed/computer-automaton prior-work risk remains.
residual_risks: No claim of exhaustive global bibliographic priority: prior computational automata not in an indexed theorem may encode the language.
This theorem says only whether 9 divides a central trinomial coefficient, not the exact 3-adic valuation above two.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial prime-square refinement of the natural central-trinomial mod-3 digit divisibility law is an exact, compact automaton-language description. It is accompanied by an exact count of all 9-divisible values on every complete ternary block, showing a quantitatively sharp density-one law. The special adjacency rule for a unique digit 2 is not a trivial consequence of the known mod-3 Lucas product, and it identifies a mathematically natural structural gap rather than an arbitrary finite search.
